v1.subject: Разметка требования к уклону пандуса, семантический граф и CadLib

v2.subject: Таблица электрических расстояний, XML-профиль и коллизии

v3.subject: Поиск требований к объектам BIM в nanoCAD

facts.observable_fact: Уклон пандусов на путях эвакуации людей следует принимать не более 1:20.
facts.required_factual_association: The 1:20 maximum belongs to evacuation-route ramps, not all stairs or an unrelated width; preserve not more than.

facts.observable_fact: Semantic-search row 1 gives the ramp 1:20 requirement, СП 1.13130.2020, relevance 0.666163. Row 2 has a different requirement: personnel alarm route to fire-appliance room, slope 1:10 and width at least 1.4 m.
facts.required_factual_association: Do not move 1:10/1.4 m or row-2 relevance onto the evacuation ramp requirement. Row 1 relevance must remain 0.666163 if reported.

facts.observable_fact: Segmentation diagram maps prop to Уклон, subj to пандусов, rel to на, feat to путях/эвакуации/людей.
facts.required_factual_association: Report the labels with their word associations, not a generic graph or disconnected list.

facts.observable_fact: Segmentation maps deont to следует/принимать, neg to не, compr to более, quant to 1/:/20.
facts.required_factual_association: Preserve the negation/comparison/quantity relationships and actual ratio tokens.

facts.observable_fact: Source-text field contains the ramp requirement; comment field shows Введите комментарий; ID требования is 44846.
facts.required_factual_association: 44846 is requirement ID, and Введите комментарий is an empty-field placeholder, not entered content.

facts.observable_fact: Калькулятор panel is open; CADLib МиА checkbox is checked and nanoCAD is unchecked. Two numbered steps show ramp context then the maximum 1:20 requirement.
facts.required_factual_association: Distinguish checked target from unchecked target; do not claim both exports enabled.

facts.observable_fact: Классификация tab is selected; class KSI > XPG_0016 is linked to prop (Уклон), and KSI > ZF__0010 is linked to feat (evacuation-route words).
facts.required_factual_association: Keep class-to-role associations; do not turn these codes into numerical limits.

facts.observable_fact: Rule table has Проверка, Prp>XPG_0016, logic >, value 1/20; CadLib condition reads [object1.#XPG_0016]>1/20.
facts.required_factual_association: The displayed collision/check predicate is >1/20, distinct from the normative maximum <=1/20. Do not reverse the sign or claim the norm itself requires >1/20.

facts.observable_fact: CadLib Инструменты menu is open and contains Проверка коллизий.
facts.required_factual_association: Associate collision checking with the Tools menu in CadLib, not with a browser menu.

facts.observable_fact: Selected CadLib object is ОБ-0010; properties show IfcEntityLabel 107066 and IfcType IfcRamp.
facts.required_factual_association: Keep object name, entity label and IFC type associated; do not call 107066 a requirement ID.

facts.observable_fact: Electrical-clearance table uses distance mm versus nominal voltage kV. First row Аф-з has 200 at до 10, 300 at 20, 400 at 35, 900 at 110, 1300 at 150.
facts.required_factual_association: Preserve units and column associations; these are not object counts or voltages in mm.

facts.observable_fact: First row Аф-з, to extended grounded structures/internal barriers at least 2 m high, has paired values 1800/1200 under 220 kV and 2500/2000 under 330 kV.
facts.required_factual_association: Keep row description and both values under each voltage; do not invent separate subcolumn labels absent from this frame.

facts.observable_fact: Second row А1ф-з, to grounded structures including equipment head/support or wire/post/traverse, has 1600/1200 at 220 kV and 2200/1800 at 330 kV.
facts.required_factual_association: Do not merge this row with the first row, whose 220/330 values differ.

facts.observable_fact: Top fields show Выберите ячейки таблицы, текст из которых будет отображаться здесь; Выберите шаблон сниппета; Выберите сниппет-цель. Автопарсинг is checked.
facts.required_factual_association: These are selection placeholders, not selected snippet names; distinguish checked autoparsing.

facts.observable_fact: Сегментация is selected; graph contains many numbered multiport nodes and loc-rq nodes with dense connecting edges; page indicator is 1 / 24.
facts.required_factual_association: 24 is graph-page total, not collision count. Do not claim a simple two-node graph or invent exact edge semantics.

facts.observable_fact: Snippet title is Табличные двойные; hovering XML shows Сохранить в XML.
facts.required_factual_association: XML is an export action/tooltip, not a success toast or proof of completed import.

facts.observable_fact: Displayed XML includes group изоляции with NSR_КЛАСС_НАПРЯЖЕНИЯ=220, and group токоведущих частей with class=330; linked SYS_OBJECT_NAME is ОРУ 110 кВ.
facts.required_factual_association: Keep the different field/value scopes; do not overwrite 220 or 330 with the linked object name’s 110.

facts.observable_fact: CadLib import dialog Выберите импортируемый профиль is open in Downloads; type is Профили импорта (*.xml); a filename ending (3) is selected.
facts.required_factual_association: This is selecting an XML profile, not a video or PDF; do not infer success from the file chooser alone.

facts.observable_fact: Collision-check log shows Пар для анализа: 474 and Обнаружено коллизий минимального расстояния: 3; Готово button is available.
facts.required_factual_association: 474 is analysed pairs and 3 is minimum-distance collisions, not the reverse or 474 failures.

facts.observable_fact: nanoCAD x64 22 displays a building structural BIM model; Требования panel replaces the left properties view and contains Найденные, Документы, Текст требования, Значение в модели.
facts.required_factual_association: This workflow is requirements lookup inside nanoCAD, not the electrical substation collision wizard or the ramp segmentation editor.

facts.observable_fact: Found rows include IfcPlate / Металлическая пластина / 511 and IfcPile / Свая железобетонная / 142.
facts.required_factual_association: Keep exact type/name/count mapping; 511 and 142 are object counts.

facts.observable_fact: Found rows include IfcBeam / Балка / 1122, Болты фундаментные / 112, and IfcBeam / Балка железобетонная / 18.
facts.required_factual_association: Do not merge the two IfcBeam rows or swap 1122 with 112.

facts.observable_fact: Selected pile group shows document СП 22.13330.2016 Основания зданий и сооружений; selected document row is Пункт 9.36 and status is С 2017-06-17 действует, Добровольный.
facts.required_factual_association: Associate 9.36 with this document and pile selection, not a different code or row.

facts.observable_fact: Selected document is СП 63.13330.2018 Бетонные и железобетонные конструкции. Основные положения, Приложение В Расчет конструктивных систем; text starts В.20 and concerns modelling piles as reinforced concrete.
facts.required_factual_association: Preserve the document/year and appendix association; В.20 is not a count of objects.

facts.observable_fact: Found list shows IfcWall / Стена плоская / 17, IfcSlab / Плита перекрытия / 36, IfcColumn / Колонна / 156.
facts.required_factual_association: Keep wall/slab/column names, IFC classes and corresponding counts separate.

facts.observable_fact: Selected wall group has document СП 14.13330.2018 Строительство в сейсмических районах, selected Пункт 6.12.8. Visible requirement permits at most five floors for seismicity 7/8 and at most three for 9 (for other building types).
facts.required_factual_association: Do not reverse floor limits or seismicity values; preserve the visible contextual restriction rather than universalizing it.

facts.observable_fact: Selected found row is IfcPlate / FnS>C30 / 19; selected document is ГОСТ 27751-2014, section 5.2 Расчет по предельным состояниям, Добровольный.
facts.required_factual_association: 19 belongs to this class row, not to all plates; keep standard and section association.

facts.observable_fact: Browser displays specification.normacs.info/requirements/152; top status is с 01.07.2015 Добровольное. Expanded classifier sections include date ranges 01.07.2021–13.10.2021 and 14.10.2021–16.12.2021.
facts.required_factual_association: Do not conflate requirement effective date with classifier version ranges or invent a save-confirmation toast.

assessment.policy: Require the listed association, not merely the isolated number. Partial means incomplete but non-conflicting. Contradicted means wrong value/relation/state. Log unsupported extra factual claims separately. An omission is not itself a hallucination. Severity is descriptive impact, not a numerical weight. Use timestamps as anchors, not exact transition boundaries.

note: Frame files and source paths are kept in the private evidence archive, not published.
